evidence.detail: Admin check via session.get('admin') is used but not exposed to the template as a property
Buttons list has no admin-only button or link to /admin/matches
/admin/matches/ route exists in decksite (not logsite) and reads request.form (POST), not GET params — pre-filling requires either GET-param support or a POST redirect
bakert commented 'Wut? )' and silasary admitted 'Wow, I was really lazy with this one :P' — issue is intentionally underspecified

triage.notes: The feature spans two codebases (logsite button, decksite form pre-fill). 'Pre-filled' is ambiguous: if it means just a link to /admin/matches/ with player names as query params, the decksite controller also needs to be updated to read request.args. Issue needs a clearer spec before implementation.
